title: Code Review 2026-06-09
description: 10 prioritised items from the full-repo code review. Items 1–4 are blocking pre-launch; items 5–10 are steady-state improvements.

workstreams.title: XSS: HTML sanitization
workstreams.description: Vendor DOMPurify; shared quote-safe escHtml; apply across every vault render path.

tasks.title: Vendor DOMPurify alongside fuse.js in _common/js/vendor/
Wrap every marked.parse output with DOMPurify.sanitize in sg-article-viewer
One shared escHtml module that escapes &, <, >, ", ' (sg-escape.js; used by side-nav/sub-nav; local copies completed in viewer + shells)
Apply escHtml at every nav-derived innerHTML interpolation in sg-side-nav, sg-sub-nav, and all three SPA shells
Allowlist link protocols in marked renderer (https?, mailto:, relative URLs only)
Replace onclick-string patterns with addEventListener + dataset (dev shell CI rows, run cards)

workstreams.title: Lambda: host allowlist (RCE surface)
workstreams.description: Lambda@Edge builds orchestrator URL from request headers, then import()s it. Validate host against hardcoded allowlist before fetching.

tasks.title: Add ALLOWED_HOSTS allowlist in infra/lambda-edge/sg-edge-render/index.mjs before orchestrator fetch (shipped v0.1.7)

workstreams.title: CI: pinning + permissions
workstreams.description: Prod dispatch deploys whatever branch it runs on; external actions pinned to mutable @dev branch with secrets:inherit.

tasks.title: Add ref: ${{ inputs.git_branch }} to every checkout in ci-pipeline.yml (fixes prod-deploys-any-branch)

Add least-privilege permissions blocks (default read; increment-tag + deploy write)
Migrate static AWS keys → OIDC role assumption — DEFERRED: needs an IAM role ARN provisioned on the AWS side

workstreams.title: CI: gating tests
workstreams.description: Push → deploy with zero checks. Smoke test is non-gating. Edge-render harness and Playwright spec both unwired from CI.

tasks.title: Post-deploy smoke now retries + exits non-zero on failure (deploy_static_site.py)

package.json + portable Playwright (env-driven URL/browser); post-deploy e2e job for qa+dev
